metadata.title: Watch Arrows
metadata.description: Bring arrows so the village watch can answer trouble before it reaches the doors.

tracker.text: Bring 16 arrows for the village watch.

offer.label: Watch Arrows
lines: The watch has bows and too many empty quivers. Sixteen arrows would put some distance between trouble and our doors.
A pillager is easier to answer from the wall than from the wheat field.
Bring 16 arrows for the village watch. I will make the reward worth the trouble.
